title: Senior Director, Creative Strategy
description:
ABOUT DARKROOM

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a dedicated, senior role on a single account, helping a key client bring a brand new product to market, with Darkroom owning all media channels. You are the creative lead on that engagement, accountable for the brand's whole creative story, from positioning and messaging down to the hook on a 15-second ad.

That makes this different from a typical agency creative role. You are not spreading yourself across a portfolio. You are going deep on one enterprise client, setting creative positioning with their leadership, then sitting with designers and editors to tighten the frame across paid, social, and retention.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Responsibilities:

- Brand & Creative Positioning: Own creative positioning for the brand and its new product launch. Turn brand strategy, audience insight, and competitive context into a clear point of view on what a brand says and how it looks and sounds.

- Copy & Messaging: Lead copy and messaging end to end, from messaging frameworks, taglines, and campaign lines to ad copy, email, and SMS. Flex tone by channel and funnel stage, and be the person who delivers when a client asks you to "punch up the copy."

- Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Lead creative strategy across paid (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon), organic social (Instagram, TikTok), and retention (email, SMS, lifecycle), so every channel ladders up to one brand story.

- Campaigns: Concept and lead the launch campaign and the large, integrated campaigns that follow, from the big idea through briefs, production, launch, and measuring what they actually did.

- Testing & Learning: Own the testing roadmap: what gets tested, in what order, against what hypothesis, and what a real win looks like before spend goes live. Balance brand-building work with performance.

- Hands-On Creative Direction: Work directly with Designers and Editors, briefing statics, motion, short-form video, UGC, and storyboards. Give sharp, tactical feedback on design, pacing, and edit structure, and jump into Figma or an edit yourself when it's faster. This isn't the role for strategy-only folks.

- Data Analysis: Read performance data across paid, social, and retention, from ad metrics to open rate, click rate, and repeat purchase, and turn it into the next concept.

- Executive Presentation & Client Leadership: Present creative strategy and campaigns to the client's leadership with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale. Own the creative relationship on the account and navigate pushback with ease.

At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences - wherever their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter.
We are now looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our team in the United States.
For this role, we’re looking for someone who is urgently curious. You want to learn Inriver inside-out, and you want to do it now, so you can help your customers get more from the platform.
About the role
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you are the customer’s go-to Inriver expert and trusted operational partner for our larger customers. You combine strong relationship ownership with Super User- and Administrator-level knowledge of Inriver’s concepts, features, and functionality. You apply this expertise to drive adoption, remove barriers, and make Inriver an integral part of how customers work - not another hurdle they need to overcome.

You are expected to know the product inside and out - including data modelling, workflows, syndication, enrichment, imports and exports, permissions, dashboards, and the everyday tasks your customers perform. When customers are stuck, uncertain, or not using the platform to its full potential, you will be able to guide them confidently and provide practical, hands-on support.

Working closely with Account Management, Business Solution Architects, Product, and Professional Services, you guide customers throughout their journey - from onboarding and adoption to business reviews and expansion. You take ownership of the health of your portfolio, ensuring customers realize value quickly, continue to do so as their needs evolve, and view Inriver as an indispensable part of their business.

With adoption as your north star, you build trusted relationships, develop customer advocates, proactively reduce risk, and create opportunities for long-term retention and growth.

What you’ll do

• Own the ongoing relationship for a portfolio of customers as their primary point of contact, trusted advisor, and internal advocate.

• Act as a hands-on Inriver Super User/product expert, confidently guiding customers through the platform’s features and everyday tasks so they can work independently.

• Take ownership of the customer relationship after Go-Live and drive platform adoption as the core measure of success, translating each customer’s goals into Success Plans with measurable milestones, reviewed through regular Business Reviews.

• Proactively identify and mitigate account risk to prevent churn, and recognize expansion opportunities, partnering with Account Management ahead of renewals and growth conversations.

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding adoption blockers and product feedback back to Product and Support.

• Stay up to date on industry trends and share relevant knowledge, including through best practice sessions and walkthroughs.

• Stay informed on escalations and technical issues affecting your accounts, and elevate to the appropriate teams when needed

What you’ll bring
We don’t expect you to tick every single box, but for this role we do need most of the following:

✔️Platform mastery: Willingness and proven ability to become a Super User/Administrator-level expert in Inriver - or demonstrable expertise as a power user/admin in a comparable PIM, DAM, MDM, PXM, or enterprise SaaS platform.

✔️A genuine curiosity to learn the product inside-out and sit hands-on in the platform with customers, translating their day-to-day challenges into the right way to do it in the platform.

✔️Customer Success experience: 5-8+ years in Customer Success, Solution Consulting, application/product support, or a customer-facing SaaS role where deep product knowledge was central to the job.

✔️Adoption mindset: Experience driving product adoption and measuring success through usage, KPIs, and value realization.

✔️Digital commerce/product data understanding: Solid grasp of product information management

title: Head of Compliance

Company Overview
team.blue is an ecosystem of 60+ successful brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.3 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.
team.blue 's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.
Role:
We are looking for a hands-on, tech-savvy Head of Compliance to build and lead team.blue ’s central Compliance function within group legal. Regulation is expanding quickly (AI Act, DSA, Data Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR) and we operate across a fragmented, multi-country footprint. meets a fragmented, multi-geography footprint. This role is to turn that regulatory load into something teams can act upon themselves, rather than something we chase reactively.
Our operating philosophy is simple: enable, don’t gate - default to “how”, not “no”. Compliance is a growth lever, not a checkpoint. You will run a risk-based, pragmatic and scalable function: focus effort where likelihood × impact is highest, standardise and automate the routine, and reserve deep expertise for where it genuinely adds value. Good enough and fast beats perfect and late.
Given the size and geographical diversity of the group, the ambition is not a separate compliance silo. The function is embedded in group legal and works through co-creation: we set the standard once at the centre, enable divisions to self-serve through shared tools, and co-create with divisional General Counsels and legal-on-the-ground, who own their product and commercial risk posture within that standard.
Team & Leadership Scope:
This is a people-leadership role. You will lead and develop a central compliance capability, with the following reporting into you:

• Privacy Counsels - the group’s data-protection and GDPR specialists.

• AI Counsels - the group’s AI Act and AI-governance specialists.

• A general compliance risk-monitoring and assurance function - regulatory watch, continuous risk monitoring, the assurance loop and adoption tracking (AI-enabled).

You steer this team to standardise once and scale everywhere, and you steer, rather than manage, local legal counsels to embed compliance in the business lines.
You will also have access to the operational Legal Hub, headed by the legal ops lead, and act as a spoke to it: you deploy your standards, policies and playbooks as self-serve templates and automation through the Hub, and draw on its shared tooling, regulatory-watch and risk analytics.
You set and steer the standard; the Hub is the delivery layer that scales it.

Compliance Advisory & Implementation

• Act as a first-line (1LOD) advisory function embedded in group legal, working alongside legal and the business rather than at arm’s length - enabling delivery, not blocking it.

• Drive the practical implementation of regulatory requirements into the business lines - translating obligations into operational change and self-serve readiness, not just written guidance.

• Apply a risk-based approach to set priorities across the group’s brands and jurisdictions, as a joint call with the business, not a legal veto.

Regulatory Scope - Data & Technology

• Own the group compliance agenda on data- and technology-driven legislation, which forms the core of the remit: GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act, DORA and NIS2.

• Coordinate the group’s Digital Services Act (DSA) standard centrally - setting a single approach to avoid fragmented entity-level reporting - while the operational abuse-report handling is executed by the divisions (see Scope Boundaries).

• Set the group standard, policies and playbooks on these topics, and deploy them

title: Senior Data Scientist (SDE)
description:
Cardiovascular care is often the #1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. Karoo deploys a value-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. Karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including First Trust Capital Partners and BIP Ventures, and has near and medium-term plans for further rounds.

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

Overview

Location: Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.-based

Type: Full-time technical role

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum.

This is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.

The Role

Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated developer to join our Engineering team. As a data scientist at Karoo Health , you show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.

In order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well-designed, high-quality solutions. You have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. Knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward.

When applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.

What You'll Do

•
Design and Architect Data Systems : Lead the design, construction, installation, and optimization of highly reliable, scalable, and secure data architecture.

•
Design Core Healthcare Data Models: Own the design and evolution of foundational data models and schemas from the ground up, leveraging industry standards such as TUVA, OMOP and FHIR to translate clinical, operational, product, and reporting needs into scalable table structures, entities, and relationships.

•
Develop Data Pipelines : Build and maintain complex, production-grade data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich and normalize large volumes of healthcare data ensuring consistency, usability, and data integrity across downstream applications.

•
Data Quality and Governance : Establish and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data used for analytics.

•
Performance Optimization : Implement query tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies to maximize the performance and efficiency of data processing systems and data retrieval.

•
Cloud Infrastructure : Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure-as-code best practices.

•
Safeguard Data : Ensure strict compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and implement data security best practices.

•
Build and Maintain EMR Integrations

title: Senior Director, Franchise Commercial Execution
description:
Job Description Summary:
Location: Charlotte, NC

The Senior Director II, Franchise Commercial Execution, leads the design, integration, and governance of the end-to-end commercial execution system for Coca-Cola Consolidated, the largest bottler in the North America Operating Unit. The role goes beyond improving execution within today’s framework: it builds the operating model that connects enterprise, category, channel, and customer strategy to bottler adoption, field execution, and measurable marketplace outcomes that deliver sustainable, profitable growth.

Partnering with Franchise, Commercial, Customer, RGM, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Field Operations, and bottler leaders, the role brings fragmented capabilities into one execution architecture with clear decision rights, standards, routines, and accountability. The position leads the Commercial Execution tower and a team responsible for commercial plans and execution results across the total beverage portfolio, including Advanced Hydration, while ensuring market requirements and bottler feasibility shape plans before deployment.

What You'll Do for Us

•
Design the future-state operating model. Establish a future-ready vision and one-to-three-year plans for commercial execution excellence. Define and align decision rights, governance, roles, routines, escalation paths, and accountability across Franchise Operations, Commercial, Customer, RGM, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, Field Operations, and bottler leadership; remove disconnected handoffs.

•
Connect strategy to marketplace execution. Lead the commercial agenda across the total beverage portfolio, translating NAOU category, channel, customer, and geographic priorities into a connected process spanning commercialization, bottler plans, annual execution calendars, field standards, measurement, and corrective action. Translate objectives into transaction and volume plans across channels, geographies, customers, and the bottling system.

•
Integrate execution capabilities. Connect PICOS, ESH, MSC, CDE/coolers, space, commercialization, On-Premise, customer programs, Franchise Operations, and performance tracking into a common execution architecture with consistent standards, owners, measures, and actions.

•
Shape plans before field deployment. Partner directly with senior Commercial and Customer leaders to incorporate consumer, shopper, customer, and competitive insights alongside execution feasibility, bottler capability, equipment, package, space, supply, and market requirements into plans upfront. Align bottler senior leadership on priorities, incentives, performance expectations, and execution requirements.

•
Create the performance and intervention system. Establish common measures, leading indicators, scorecards, and thresholds that trigger corrective action, escalation, or resource reallocation through agreed governance. Improve PICOS compliance, in-stocks, void reduction, merchandising standards, and execution consistency. When results miss plan, distinguish strategy, customer alignment, supply, bottler capability, and field execution gaps and direct the appropriate intervention with accountable partners. Lead in-year delivery and recommend acceleration actions with Commercial and Finance leaders.

•
Build organizational capability. Lead the Commercial Execution tower; coach and develop a high-performing team; and establish repeatable approaches, tools, processes, and practices that enable multiple teams to deliver at scale. Strengthen data, insights, technology, and analytics in planning and decision-making, and build cross-functional alignment and accountability.

•
Protect system value and secure alignment. Lead complex negotiations and influence senior franchise, bottler, customer, and NAOU stakeholders. Balance customer needs, bottler profitability, system revenue, operating income, volume, and long-term system health in commercial decisions and investment recommendations.

UNTERNEHMENSÜBERSICHT

Rohlik wurde 2014 in der Tschechischen Republik gegründet und ist heute der führende E-Grocery-Anbieter in Mitteleuropa. Das Unternehmen ist bereits in Tschechien (Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz), Ungarn (Kifli.hu http://Kifli.hu), Österreich (Gurkerl.at http://Gurkerl.at) und Deutschland (Knuspr.de http://Knuspr.de) vertreten und expandiert derzeit nach Italien und Rumänien.

In dieser Position arbeitest du eng mit den Area Managern zusammen, um Teams von Mitarbeitenden zu führen, reibungslose Arbeitsabläufe sicherzustellen und die täglichen operativen Prozesse zu optimieren.

Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit den Mitarbeitenden, behältst ihre Leistung im Blick, verteilst Aufgaben und koordinierst die täglichen Abläufe innerhalb deines Bereichs.

- Du kennst die gesamten Lagerprozesse - vom Wareneingang bis zum finalen Versand - und stellst sicher, dass alle operativen Standards eingehalten werden (5S, Arbeitssicherheit und Genauigkeit).

- Du überwachst die Arbeitsabläufe, erkennst Engpässe und arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Management an Prozessverbesserungen, um die wichtigsten Leistungsziele zu erreichen.

- Du führst Qualitäts- und Sicherheitskontrollen durch und stellst sicher, dass die Richtlinien und Standards von Rohlik eingehalten werden.

- Du löst operative Probleme direkt vor Ort und eskalierst wichtige Themen bei Bedarf, um Unterbrechungen im Arbeitsablauf möglichst gering zu halten.

- Du erfasst und analysierst Leistungskennzahlen wie Bearbeitungsgeschwindigkeit, Produktivität und Fehlerquoten, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

- Du unterstützt bei der Schichtplanung und Personaleinsatzplanung, um die Effizienz des Teams optimal zu gestalten.

- Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeitenden, kümmerst dich um ihre Anliegen und unterstützt sie mit deiner Anleitung und deinem Feedback, um ein leistungsstarkes Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen.

- Du förderst eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, des Engagements und einer positiven Teamatmosphäre.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

DAS ERWARTEN WIR VON DIR

- Einen Schulabschluss (mindestens mittlerer Bildungsabschluss oder vergleichbar) oder eine höhere Qualifikation.

- Mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung, Logistik, Produktion oder im operativen Bereich.

- Führungskompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, ein Team zu motivieren und anzuleiten.

- Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) sowie die Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren.

- Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Schichten zu arbeiten, einschließlich an Wochenenden und Feiertagen.

DAS IST EIN PLUS

- Erste Erfahrungen als Process Assistant, Lead Associate oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition in der Logistik oder im Lagerbereich.

- Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Warehouse-Management-Systemen (WMS) und der Bestandsverwaltung.

- Verständnis von Lean- oder Six-Sigma-Prinzipien zur kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung.

- Die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu koordinieren und auch unter Zeitdruck Termine und Ziele einzuhalten.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

- Einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das den Online-Lebensmittelhandel neu definiert und neue Maßstäbe in den Bereichen Logistik und Kunden

Working alongside experienced analog designers, you will help design, simulate and verify ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL building blocks on advanced FinFET technology nodes, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in analog circuit design who want to learn fast through deep, hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager: Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Analog & Mixed-Signal Block Design: Design and optimise sub-blocks of ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL circuits (e.g. amplifiers, comparators, bias circuits, references, clock buffers) under the guidance of senior designers.

• Simulation and Validation: Run transistor-level simulations (DC, AC, transient, noise, Monte Carlo and PVT corners) and mixed-signal verification using Cadence, AMS and SystemVerilog to confirm robust performance across operating conditions.

• Performance Optimisation: Learn and apply design techniques to improve key parameters such as gain, bandwidth, linearity, noise, jitter, power consumption and speed.

• Layout Collaboration: Work closely with layout engineers to communicate matching, symmetry and parasitic-sensitive nets, and run post-layout extracted simulations to close the design.

• Modelling & Scripting: Build behavioural models (e.g. Verilog-A) and scripts (e.g. Python, SKILL or OCEAN) to speed up simulation, analysis and design-check flows.

• Silicon Characterization Support: Help prepare test plans and support lab characterisation and debug of silicon as projects progress.

• Design Documentation: Document your designs, simulation results and design-review material clearly, supporting efficient knowledge sharing within the team.

• Technology Awareness: Keep learning about advances in high-speed SerDes, data converters and chiplet interfaces such as UCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related field, with a focus on analog/mixed-signal circuit design (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)

• 0-2 years of industry experience, including internships, placements or research projects

• Strong grasp of analog fundamentals: CMOS device physics, small-signal analysis, feedback and stability, noise, and mismatch

• Hands-on circuit design and simulation experience with Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre or similar tools, through coursework, thesis or internship projects

• Understanding of at least one of: data converters (ADC/DAC), PLLs/clocking, or high-speed TX/RX circuits

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail

Nice-to-have:

• Thesis, research or internship work on FinFET or other advanced-node technologies

• A completed tape-out and/or lab measurement experience

• Scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, SKILL or shell) and comfort in a Linux environment

• Publications or conference contributions in circuits (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, CICC, ESSCIRC)

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

As a Senior Product Manager on the Payments Platform team within the Platform product group, you'll own how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase. Payments Platform builds and runs the systems that move customer money in and out of Coinbase, covering bank transfers, card payments, wires and real-time rails. Your work sits directly on revenue and customer trust: if a customer can't add a payment method, nothing else happens.

What you’ll do: 

• Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase, including the full funnel from first screen through linking, verification, and failure recovery.

• Drive intelligent routing of payment onboarding across multiple payment service providers and banks, picking the path most likely to succeed and cheapest to run so a single provider problem never becomes a customer outage.

• Shape the approach for confirming that a payment method belongs to the customer, partnering with Risk and Compliance to hold a measured line on fraud loss versus conversion.

• Partner with Business Development and external bank and processor partners on commercial terms, integrations, and the next wave of payment capabilities.

• Lead payment method cost and performance reporting end to end, surfacing tradeoffs to senior leadership and building platform capabilities that other product teams can reuse without rebuilding the plumbing.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 7+ years of product management experience with depth in payments, money movement, or financial platforms, and a track record of owning a payment or money movement funnel end to end at scale with measurable results.

• Working knowledge of how card payments and bank transfers actually work, including declines, retries, verification, tokenization, and routing, with the ability to go deep with engineers on service architecture, APIs, and routing logic.

• Strong analytical instincts, including designing experiments and holding a measured line on tradeoffs when the easy answer and the right answer are not the same.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join a small, high-leverage team inside the Case Management Platform (CMP) organization. This is a new and intentionally unique role: you will sit organizationally within CMP - the engine that drives Natera's cases from order through result - and work shoulder-to-shoulder on priorities set by the commerce side of the business. Your job is to bridge the gap between how Natera sells, orders, and interacts with customers and how Natera fulfills every one of those commitments in the lab.

You will be a force multiplier - fluent in modern AI tools, an orchestrator of agents, and comfortable owning problems end-to-end from a napkin sketch through production. 

If you light up at the intersection of commerce workflows and operational systems, build with AI as a native part of your toolkit, and want to work on software whose outcomes are measured in patient impact - this is a role worth your attention.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own high-impact initiatives end-to-end - from problem framing through design, implementation, release, and operation - in service of commerce-driven priorities that land in CMP

• Design and build cloud-native services on AWS, with a strong bias toward stateless, event-driven architectures (AWS Lambda and similar serverless patterns, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB/RDS)

• Act as an orchestrator of AI agents and AI-assisted workflows: compose, direct, and evaluate agent systems to accelerate development, reduce manual toil, and solve problems that would otherwise require a much larger team

• Translate ambiguous business needs - spanning commerce systems and fulfillment operations - into clear technical specifications, APIs, and operations-friendly services

• Write your own stories; break down epics, identify dependencies, estimate complexity, and drive delivery without needing tickets handed to you

• Set the technical bar through strong code, thoughtful design reviews, and mentorship of other engineers across CMP

• Partner directly with commerce product managers, business stakeholders, and CMP peers; translate between those worlds and shield each from the other's complexity

• Participate in on-call rotations and production support; own the fix when something you built breaks, regardless of who wrote the original code

• Challenge the status quo; propose better patterns, tools, and ways of working - and bring teammates along

• Deliver quality software in a regulated environment: automation-first testing, shift-left mindset, "works on my machine" is never the answer

Compliance and training

• This role works with Protected Health Information (PHI) on a regular basis in both paper and electronic form

• Employee must complete HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance, and security training within the first 30 days of hire, and maintain current status on all Natera training requirements

• Employee must pass a post-offer criminal background check

QUALIFICATIONS

• BS in Computer Science, a comparable program, or equivalent experience; MS preferred

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful time building complex data or process-management applications

• Strong fluency in Java or another modern object-oriented language (Kotlin, C#, Python with OO design, etc.); comfortable moving between languages when the job calls for it

• Deep hands-on experience with AWS, including serverless and stateless patterns (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, event-driven messaging) and relational and non-relational data stores

• Demonstrated adoption of AI-assisted development - not just "I've used Copilot," but a genuine, current practice of composing and orchestrating AI tools and agents to deliver real work

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems, including observability, resilience, security, and performance in production

• Strong SQL and data modeling skills

title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, Greater Philadelphia Area
description:
Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care-but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in.
 
As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community.
 
 
Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in person approximately once per month to each account for 1-3 days, often as day trips (supporting accounts in Philadelphia and southern New Jersey). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, so some months may feel lighter or heavier than others.
 
Location Requirement: This is primarily a remote role, but candidates must live within a reasonable driving distance or have easy regional flight access to accommodate these monthly multi-day on-site account visits.

Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
 
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
 
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
 
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

title: Director Sales
description:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As Director Sales at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6-8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

- Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

- Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

- Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

- Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

- Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.

WHO YOU ARE

- You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

- You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

- You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

- You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

- You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

- Building a team excites you more than your own quota.

THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF…

- you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

- you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

- you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

- you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.

WHY NOW

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

title: Proofreader Remote

We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Proofreader to join our team. As a Proofreader, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of written materials before they are published or shared with clients. You will review various content types, including reports, articles, marketing materials, and digital content, to identify and correct errors in grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, and style consistency. The ideal candidate will have excellent language skills, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to meet deadlines while maintaining high standards of quality.
Key Responsibilities

•
Review Written Content : Examine text for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and syntax errors.

•
Correct Formatting Issues : Ensure consistency in headings, fonts, spacing, and other formatting details.

•
Ensure Consistency in Style : Verify that the content adheres to the company’s or client’s style guidelines, such as APA, MLA, or internal branding standards.

•
Fact-Checking : Confirm the accuracy of factual information, including dates, statistics, names, and references.

•
Collaborate with Writers : Provide constructive feedback to writers and content creators to improve clarity and readability.

•
Final Quality Check : Perform a final review of documents before publication or submission to ensure they are error-free and polished.

•
Adaptation for Different Formats : Adjust content to fit different formats such as print, web, or social media platforms.

•
Work on Tight Deadlines : Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring all proofreading tasks are completed within specified timelines.

•
Track Edits and Changes : Use tools such as Microsoft Word’s track changes feature to highlight and document corrections.

•
Maintain Confidentiality : Handle sensitive content with discretion and professionalism.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Strong knowledge of grammar, punctuation, and style rules.

• Experience with various style guides (APA, Chicago, etc.).

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
tags: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
description: Emerging computing technologies - non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets - offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results - compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts - into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. <p

title: Organic Growth Manager (SEO & AI Search)
description:
Your Mission

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're reconnecting one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries with AI: general contractors publish their tenders on Cosuno and find the right subcontractors, and subcontractors find the projects that fit them and win more of them. As our Organic Growth Manager, you make Cosuno the answer when contractors and trade firms search, on Google and in AI assistants: through our blog, our website and Marketplace pages, and the sources AI answers rely on. And you join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, the website relaunch with our agency, which you'll use to grow organic traffic significantly. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you'll do

- You build our blog into a steady source of qualified sign-ups: an editorial plan from search data, sales calls and trade press, original research from our platform data, and customer stories, written to a high German standard with freelance writers and AI tools.

- You own website SEO: public Marketplace pages, landing pages and programmatic trade and region pages, plus technical health, structure and speed.

- You make Cosuno the source AI assistants cite (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, structured content and a tracked set of the prompts our customers ask.

- You start our content partnerships: guest posts, joint studies and collaborations with trade media and partners that earn links and mentions. Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you also keep organic LinkedIn and our founders' posts running, then hand them over.

- Your big project in year one: the website relaunch. Our agency builds the new site and owns sitemap and design; you are their SEO sparring partner and the owner of SEO for the move: you set the requirements, challenge the structure, own redirects and migration checks, and turn the relaunch into a clear jump in organic traffic. Until it goes live, you make the small changes on the current site that matter most.

- You use AI to make organic faster and better: with our GTM & Growth Engineer you keep automating research, briefs, content and reporting, and test new formats, landing pages and free tools built on our platform data. You pick the smart solution, not the shiny one, and scale what brings sign-ups.

- You measure the path from impression to qualified sign-up and demo request, and report what organic contributes.

What You Bring

- You've owned SEO and content for a B2B or two-sided platform and can show growth in qualified sign-ups or pipeline, not just rankings.

- Strong technical SEO: you've owned SEO through a site migration or relaunch and grown traffic through it.

- Hands-on experience with AI search and how language models choose their sources.

- You write excellent German, brief writers well and turn data into blog posts and stories that search, AI answers and journalists pick up.

- You're data-driven and at home in Search Console, GA4, Semrush or similar.

- You work AI-first: you set the strategy, automate what can be automated with our engineer and steer writers and the agency, rather than write everything yourself. You get things done and learn fast in a small team.

- Native-level German and fluent English: most of our content is German.

Your Benefits

- Room to shape and grow: You own organic growth from the ground up, including the website relaunch, our biggest marketing project of the year.

- AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better - and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

- Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

- Work-life balance:

title: Data Engineer
description:
Position Highlights
Position Title: Data Engineer
FLSA Classification: Exempt
Location: Remote; must be based in the United States. Up to 10% domestic travel may be required.
Salary Range: $103,500 - $143,500 annually, plus benefits. Individual salary offers will be based on experience and qualifications unique to each candidate.
Position Type: Grant-funded, limited-term opportunity
Position End Date: June 30, 2027
Overview
The Data Engineer will play a key role in advancing the CDC Foundation 's mission by designing, building, and maintaining data infrastructure for a public health organization. This position supports the Workforce Acceleration Initiative (WAI), a federally funded CDC Foundation program dedicated to helping public health agencies accelerate information system improvements through technology and data expertise.
Working within the Chickasaw Nation Department of Health (CNDH), Division of Public Health, the Data Engineer will collaborate in planning and developing solutions for interoperable data generation, storage, processing, and analysis across systems supporting tribal public health operations. The role will partner closely with data content experts, analysts, data scientists, data modelers, data warehouse architects, IT professionals, and other organizational staff to design and implement scalable, sustainable solutions that meet agency needs.
In addition to technical responsibilities, the Data Engineer will provide training and mentorship to Division of Public Health staff to support capacity building and promote long-term system sustainability.
The Data Engineer will be employed by the CDC Foundation and assigned to the CNDH Division of Public Health. This position is eligible for a fully remote work arrangement for candidates based in the United States.
Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain data systems and pipelines that support the efficient and reliable ingestion, processing, transformation, and storage of data.

• Collect data from multiple sources; cleanse, transform, and validate data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity before loading into data storage platforms and data warehouses.

• Optimize data pipelines, infrastructure, and workflows to improve performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Monitor data pipelines and platforms for performance issues, errors, and anomalies, implementing corrective actions as needed.

• Implement and maintain appropriate security controls and data governance practices to protect sensitive and confidential information.

• Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business partners to understand data requirements and ensure data infrastructure supports organizational goals and objectives.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design scalable, sustainable data solutions that meet business and public health needs.

• Develop, implement, and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of organizational data.

• Design and manage data storage solutions, including relational databases, NoSQL databases, and enterprise data warehouses.

• Stay current on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data engineering, incorporating innovative solutions into the organization's data ecosystem.

• Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to staff and project team members.

• Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels to gather requirements, provide project updates, and present technical solutions and findings.

At NIQ, developing our people is how our strategy comes to life, and culture is what sustains it. Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

- Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

- Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

- Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

- See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

- Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

- Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

- Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.
